<div class="card-body">
'''Frostbite''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊凍傷</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス星系上に配備する。各プレイヤーのターンの終了時に、毎回、マーカー位置で“夜間状態”の場所にいるそのプレイヤーのキャラクター１人につき、そのプレイヤーは１フォース（キャラクターが行方不明の場合は２フォース）を失う。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Frostbite-PSA-170462292.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「そうなったら、あんたとは地獄で再会だ！」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Frostbite.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on the Hoth system. At the end of each player's turn, lose 1 Force for each of that player's characters at a nighttime marker site (2 if missing).

'''Lore:'''
"If it comes to that, I'll see you in hell!"
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Frostbite]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
